description: This file contains the implementation of a Luhn algorithm-based identifier validator for the OpenMRS project, specifically for validating and generating patient identifiers with a check digit.

classes.name: LuhnIdentifierValidator
classes.description: A validator class implementing the Luhn algorithm for patient identifiers, extending BaseHyphenatedIdentifierValidator.

methods.name: getCheckDigit
methods.description: Calculates the Luhn check digit for a given undecorated identifier string.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the validator.

methods.name: getAllowedCharacters
methods.description: Returns the characters allowed in identifiers.

methods.name: getValidIdentifier
methods.description: Generates a valid identifier with a check digit appended, throwing exception if input is invalid.
